title: Auto retail fell 23.8% in October. Read it twice.
takeaways: 31.72 lakh vehicles retailed in October 2026, down 23.8% year on year.
Up 25.05% on September: Diwali moved to November.
EVs hit a record 3.55 lakh units, 11.5% of retail.
Heavy CVs grew 28.95%; tractors had their best October.
PV dealer stock sits at 43–45 days, unchanged from September.
source_note: Sources: FADA via DD India, KNN, Autocar Professional, Open Magazine
